title: The Himalayas
text: The Himalayas are a mountain range in Asia, forming the world's highest mountain range, separating the plains of the Indian subcontinent from the Tibetan Plateau. The range contains nine of the world's ten highest peaks, including Mount Everest (8,848.86 m), K2, and Kangchenjunga. The Himalayas extend across approximately 2,400 km through five countries: Pakistan, India, Nepal, China, and Bhutan. The mountains were formed by the collision of the Indian and Eurasian tectonic plates beginning around 50 million years ago. The Himalayas are the source of several major river systems, including the Indus, the Ganges, and the Brahmaputra, which support over 600 million people.
